### **What Materials Are Plastic Bags Made From?**

Nearly all types of plastic bags are made with polyethylene, as it gives us strength and flexibility. Also, its protective covering from moisture.

Common materials include:

- **LDPE (Low-Density Polyethylene) Plastic Bags**

These highly flexible, soft LDPE (Low-Density Polyethylene) polythene bags are widely used for the purpose of packaging. Goods can be packaged and stored for commercial use using LDPE plastic bags.

- **HDPE (High-Density Polyethylene) Plastic Bags**

These are much stronger, stiffer and ideal for holding shop bags, groceries, heavy objects and much more. The thickness of the material should be selected depending on the size of goods being carried as well as its applications.
